column1: # A162 corpus: label<TAB>PLAN.md ## Contracts bullet body. M mandatory, I information only, N nothing.
# Decisions per class: a declared entry point (method+path, endpoint, webhook, queue consumer, rpc method, graphql mutation,
# cli flag or command) with new or changed input is M; a bare noun mention, an unchanged or output-only bullet, or a
# declared entry point without new input is I; its own removal, or no entry word at all, is N.
